title: Explain missing declared environment values in projectless local sessions
outcome: Projectless local sessions receive names-only missing-environment notices consistent with their UNKNOWN checks.
acceptance: For a local session without a project, derive declared-environment notices from its executing/named root against an empty configured selection instead of suppressing the notice.
Behavioral fixture covers projectless local missing-value notice and UNKNOWN, preserving remote-session suppression and value redaction.
